source: Authored from Runware's SDXL upscaler table and the Real-ESRGAN model author's model zoo and anime inference guide. No dedicated provider-returned standalone schema is claimed.

selection.statement: Authored supported subset using the retained sibling-schema acquisition identified by source_schema_sha256 and current official model mapping. Factor 4 is selected from the provider mapping and the checkpoint's native 4x scale. This is not a provider-returned standalone anime-6b schema or a measured visual-quality claim.

model.title: Model
model.description: Identifier of the model to use for generation.

upscaleFactor.title: Upscale Factor
upscaleFactor.description: Factor by which to upscale the generated image. This interface accepts only 4.

includeCost.title: Include Cost
includeCost.description: Include task cost in the response.

uploadEndpoint.title: Upload Endpoint
uploadEndpoint.description: URL to upload content via HTTP PUT. The request body will contain the raw binary data.

ttl.title: TTL
ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) in seconds for generated content. Only applies when `outputType` is `URL`.

outputQuality.title: Output Quality
outputQuality.description: Compression quality of the output. Higher values preserve quality but increase file size.

outputType.title: Output Type
outputType.description: Image output is delivered by URL.

outputFormat.title: Output Format
outputFormat.description: File format for the generated image.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: The unified payload wrapper for complex media assets dictating image, video or audio inference constraints.
